generals.title: Generals
generals.tip2: Be first to capture uncontested buildings in Phase 1.
generals.tip3: Please don't hoard free healing speedups: Swordland healing is free.
generals.tip4: Please don't hoard free march speedups: Swordland march time reduction is free.

understandings.title: How to Earn Relic Points
understandings.description: Understanding where points come from helps you choose the best strategy.

firstCapture.note: The first alliance to capture a building receives a major bonus.

buildingOccupation.note: Sword Shrine and Sanctums provide the highest point income.

lootCrates.note: Spawn when a building is captured from the enemy.

undercellars.note: Appear randomly during the End Game. Watch the minimap.

combatDefense.note: Half the points earned from attacking.

strategicBuildings.title: Strategic Buildings
strategicBuildings.description: These buildings provide powerful bonuses and should be captured as soon as they become available.

hallOfReformation.effect:
+15 percent Damage Dealt
-15 percent Damage Taken

bellTower.effect: Reduces building capture time by 50 percent

royalStables.effect: Reduces teleport cooldown by 50 percent (10 min → 5 min)

mercenaryCamp.effect: Allows you to send Mercenaries to attack enemy buildings.

attackers.title: Attackers
attackers.primaryObjectives1: Capture the assigned buildings. Assign 1–2 attackers to each building with 2–3 defenders. Use rallies when required.
attackers.primaryObjectives2: Secure all priority buildings within the first 10 minutes.
attackers.primaryObjectives4: Focus on Stables, Sanctums, and Bell Tower first.
attackers.primaryObjectives5: At 12 minutes, capture Sword Shrine and Mercenary Camp.
attackers.primaryObjectives6: Once priority buildings are secured, begin burning enemy cities.
attackers.responsibilities1: Garrison captured buildings with your strongest defensive formation.
attackers.responsibilities3: If overwhelmed, relocate to another priority building.
attackers.responsibilities4: Remain at your assigned objective unless instructed otherwise.

defenders.title: Defenders
defenders.title.primaryObjectives1: Know which building you are assigned to defend.
defenders.title.primaryObjectives3: Support attacker rallies using Chenko and Yeonwoo.
defenders.responsibilities1: After a building is captured, immediately send your strongest defensive march.
defenders.responsibilities2: Place Saul or Gordon in the left hero slot.
defenders.responsibilities4: Spread your cities to avoid giving enemies easy targets.
defenders.responsibilities6: If a building is lost, immediately gather nearby resources.
defenders.responsibilities8: Maintain control of Stables, Sanctums, Sword Shrine, Mercenary Camp, and two Abbeys whenever possible.

note.title: Important
note.tip1: Your first teleport is free—use it to position near your assigned target immediately
note.tip2: Empty buildings are wasted opportunities—even weak defenders prevent solo captures
note.tip3: Additional Attackers should burn enemy cities to force teleports, disrupting their positioning.
note.tip4: Defenders should not remain at the base. Instead, teleport between two or three nearby buildings where enemy players cannot easily spot your city.
note.tip5: Don't overcommit to one building; spread defenders across multiple structures
note.tip6: Stables and Sanctums remain the highest priority.

buildings.reformation: Reformation (only if your alliance has a clear advantage)

phase3.title: Phase 3 ― Endgame (Final 15 Minutes)
phase3.tip2: Maintain control of all occupied buildings.
phase3.tip3: Defenders must immediately request support if under pressure.
phase3.tip4: When appropriate, attackers should continuously burn enemy cities using rallies or solo attacks.

note.title: Last Push Strategy (at 06:00) if we are losing on points or becoming overwhelmed
note.tip1: Launch a double rally on the Swordshrine, led by our two strongest rally leaders. ratio 50-20-30
note.tip2: All available players must be ready to join the rally immediately.
note.tip3: If the rally succeeds, defenders who have a Teleport item should immediately teleport around the Swordshrine (center).
note.tip4: Secure and collect the Loot Crates before the enemy can reach them.
